title: OmniGet v0.10.0: OpenNami & In-App Alerts
body: OmniGet has been upgraded with the OpenNami download architecture, dual-engine fallback, anti-bot hardening, Lao language support, and in-app announcements.
highlights: OpenNami Engine: Dual-engine fallback switches automatically when streams throttle
Anti-Bot Hardening: Handles challenge pages and protected site stream extraction
In-App Announcements: In-app modal for release updates and service notices
Lao (ລາວ) Translation: Full interface translation with bundled Noto Serif Lao
Attachments & Compatibility: Restored course attachment toggle and Linux SQLite fix
